statement: Population: patients as defined by the trial's eligibility criteria.
Treatment: the active treatment (A) versus the comparator (B), each as randomized.
Variable: Two components: completion of the trial on assigned treatment, and improvement in the primary efficacy score at the final visit among completers.

Intercurrent events: Treatment discontinuation (including switching antipsychotic or adding rescue medication not defined as part of the regimen) is handled by the composite strategy: it is part of the outcome, and no outcomes after discontinuation are modelled.

Population-level summary: Composite of the difference in completion and the difference among completers, combined by the weighted Z with prespecified relative weights 0.30 (completion) and 0.70 (efficacy); summarized by the standardized composite effect size psi with its confidence interval, reported with both components.
